newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Honam to boost naphtha cracking capacity.
newsitem.headline: Honam to boost naphtha cracking capacity.

text.p: South Korea's Honam Petrochemical Corp said on Monday it would expand its naphtha cracking capacity by 164,300 tonnes a year by removing production bottlenecks by July 1999.
The company said in a statement it would invest an estimated 127 billion won on the expansion. After the expansion is complete, Honam's naphtha cracking capability will be 591,800 tonnes a year.
Honam will also invest 50 billion won each in a new 100,000 tonnes-a-year high density polyethylene (HDPE) plant and a new 100,000 tonnes-a-year polypropylene (PP) plant by July 1999.
The expansion will give Honam 210,000 tonne-a-year HDPE and 240,000 tonne-a-year PP production capacity.
